definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_binder_directory()
 RETURNS TABLE(binder_id uuid, binder_name text, binder_type text, is_public boolean, owner_user_id uuid, owner_email text, owner_collector_name text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.stackr_is_trusted_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admin only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    binder.id,
    binder.name,
    binder.type::text,
    binder.is_public,
    binder.user_id,
    profile.email,
    profile.collector_name,
    binder.created_at
  from public.binders as binder
  left join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = binder.user_id
  order by binder.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

definitions.name: public.marketplace_review_queue
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.marketplace_review_queue(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(listing_id uuid, seller_user_id uuid, seller_name text, card_id text, set_id text, product_type text, product_name text, item_condition text, grade_company text, grade text, asking_price numeric, market_estimate numeric, risk_value numeric, listing_notes text, listing_images jsonb, listing_media jsonb, seller_front_image_url text, seller_back_image_url text, review_reason text, verification_status text, listing_status text, report_count bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles reviewer
    where reviewer.id = (select auth.uid())
      and reviewer.role in ('admin', 'moderator')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Marketplace reviewer access required.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    listing.id,
    listing.user_id,
    coalesce(directory.collector_name, 'Collector')::text,
    listing.card_id::text,
    listing.set_id::text,
    listing.product_type::text,
    listing.product_name::text,
    listing.condition::text,
    listing.grade_company::text,
    listing.grade::text,
    listing.asking_price::numeric,
    listing.market_estimate::numeric,
    greatest(
      coalesce(listing.asking_price, 0),
      coalesce(listing.market_estimate, 0),
      case
        when coalesce(listing.value, '') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then listing.value::numeric
        else 0
      end
    )::numeric,
    listing.listing_notes::text,
    coalesce(to_jsonb(listing.listing_images), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(listing.listing_media, '[]'::jsonb),
    listing.seller_front_image_url::text,
    listing.seller_back_image_url::text,
    listing.admin_review_reason::text,
    listing.verification_status::text,
    listing.listing_status::text,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.marketplace_listing_reports report
      where report.listing_id = listing.id
        and report.status in ('open', 'reviewing')
    )::bigint,
    listing.created_at,
    listing.updated_at
  from public.user_card_flags listing
  left join public.profile_public_directory directory on directory.id = listing.user_id
  where listing.flag_type = 'trade'
    and coalesce(listing.listing_status, 'active') = 'active'
    and (
      listing.verification_status = 'pending'
      or listing.admin_review_required = true
    )
  order by
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.marketplace_listing_reports report
      where report.listing_id = listing.id
        and report.status in ('open', 'reviewing')
    ) desc,
    greatest(
      coalesce(listing.asking_price, 0),
      coalesce(listing.market_estimate, 0),
      case
        when coalesce(listing.value, '') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then listing.value::numeric
        else 0
      end
    ) desc,
    listing.created_at asc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 100));
end;
$function$

private.stackr_is_trusted_admin
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stackr_is_trusted_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from auth.users as trusted_user
    where trusted_user.id = auth.uid()
      and trusted_user.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'stackr_admin' = 'true'
  );
$function$
